fields.meta_title: Sublease Form With Approvals and Signatures | Emergent
fields.meta_description: Build a sublease form that asks the landlord and roommates to approve a subtenant before both parties add their e-signatures.
fields.h1: Build a Sublease Form That Handles Approvals and Signatures
fields.hero_description: Build a sublease form that collects the sublet dates and rent, then asks the landlord to approve before both parties sign.
fields.features_heading: From the Request to Both Signatures
fields.features_subheading: Emergent builds the sublease form along with the approval emails and the record each sublet leaves behind.
fields.feature_1:
The whole sublet on one record

The form asks for both parties and the unit address first, then the dates and the money. Every answer lands on one sublease record, and no one retypes it into a second file.
fields.feature_2:
The landlord decides from an email

Once the subtenant submits, the app emails the landlord the subtenant's name and the dates with a link to approve or decline. The record keeps the decision and its date.
fields.feature_3:
Both e-signatures, captured in order

The app captures the subtenant's e-signature first and the tenant's second, each with the date signed. Check with an attorney whether e-signatures suit your lease first.
fields.feature_4:
Rent math for part of a space

Sublet a room or a share of a commercial unit, and the form works out the subtenant's rent from the square feet. Both parties then sign the same figure the form shows.
fields.feature_5:
Each sublease is a row you own

Every request saves as a row in a database you own, with its approvals and its end date. A property manager can filter a building by the subleases ending this month.
fields.feature_6:
A reminder before the sublet ends

Set the app to email both parties 30 days before the sublease end date. The tenant gets time to plan the move back, and the subtenant gets time to find the next apartment.

fields.usecase_heading: One Form for Four Kinds of Sublet
fields.tab_content_1:
Thea signs after Anders, on the same 11-week record

Thea Marchetti is spending the summer away and sublets her one-bedroom to Anders Lykke for 11 weeks, June 7 through August 23. The form records $1,650 a month in rent and an $800 deposit. Anders signs first, Thea signs second, and both e-signatures sit on one sublease record.
fields.tab_content_2:
With no decision in 3 days, a request goes to Hollis

Briarpoint Property Group manages 140 units, and every tenant who wants to sublet uses the same form. This week 9 requests are open. Any request still waiting after 3 days goes back to manager Hollis Brennan by email, and this morning's email lists 2 of them, each with its unit and subtenant.
fields.tab_content_3:
To the bakery, 1,200 square feet means $2,700 a month

Fallowfield Coffee Roasters leases a 4,000 square foot warehouse for $9,000 a month and sublets 1,200 square feet of it to Fenwick Street Bakery. The form divides the sublet space by the total and applies that share to the rent. The bakery's $2,700 goes on the record both businesses sign.
fields.tab_content_4:
The roommates say yes first, then it goes to the landlord

Yara Holloway is leaving her room in a shared 3-bedroom for 4 months, and Dario Mensah wants to take it. The form asks roommates Lucan Adeyemi and Sunniva Park to approve Dario before the request reaches the landlord. Yara gets an email each time an approval comes in, and the latest says 2 of 3 are in.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Sublease Form
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to create a sublease form that gathers every approval before both parties sign, then build it with Emergent.
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 List who signs and who approves
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Set the dates and the money
fields.howto_step_1_des: Read what your lease says about subletting before you build anything. Note whether it asks for written consent or a notice period, and check your lease and local law with an attorney when the clause leaves you unsure.
fields.howto_step_2_des: List every person the sublease touches: the tenant, the subtenant, the landlord, and any roommates who share the unit. Mark who only approves and who signs, since the form sends each group a different request.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Pick the start and end dates, then the monthly rent and the deposit the subtenant pays. For part of a unit or a commercial space, decide whether the rent follows the square feet or a share you agree on.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Decide who approves first. A shared apartment can ask the roommates first and send the landlord only a subtenant the household has accepted. Set how many days a request may wait before someone is reminded.
fields.howto_step_5_title: 05 Describe the form in one prompt
fields.howto_step_5_des: Write the decisions from steps 1 through 4 into a single prompt, naming roles, not people. Emergent builds the sublease form and the database behind it, and a follow-up prompt changes any part of either.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Run one fake sublease through it
fields.howto_step_6_des: Submit a test request with made-up names and your own email in every role. Check that the approval emails arrive in the order you set, that the rent figure is right, and that both signatures land on the same record.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Send the link to the subtenant
fields.howto_step_7_des: Share the form link with the subtenant once the test record looks right. After the subtenant submits, the approval requests go out in order, and each decision shows up on the record as it comes in.

faq_plan.a: A sublease form records a sublease, in which a tenant rents all or part of the place to a third person, the subtenant, for a shorter term than the original lease. It records who the parties are and what the subtenant pays for which dates. Keep the original lease beside it, because the original tenant still has to fulfill the lease obligations.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a sublease form?
faq_plan.a: Open Emergent's AI form builder and describe the sublease in plain English: who has to approve it and how the rent is set. Emergent builds the form with a database for the records, and a new prompt changes any part. Send one test sublease to your own email before the real link goes out.

faq_plan.q: What should a sublease form template include?
faq_plan.a: A sublease form template should cover the parties, the property, the term, and the money. Ask for both names and contact details, the unit address, the start and end dates, the monthly rent, the deposit, and who pays utilities. Add a landlord approval section if your lease mentions consent, and a signature block for each party.

faq_plan.q: Can I make a free sublease form online?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Emergent is free to start, and the free tier covers building and publishing. Unlike a sublease form PDF, the built form saves every answer as a record you can search. A service request form built on the same account can take the subtenant's other requests during the sublet, such as a parking permit or a spare key.

faq_plan.q: How do I get the landlord's consent through a sublease form?
faq_plan.a: Put the landlord step after the subtenant's details and before anyone signs. The app emails the landlord when the subtenant submits, and the tenant hears back either way, with the reason when the landlord declines. For the wording of the consent itself, ask an attorney who knows your lease and your area's rules.

faq_plan.q: Can a sublease form collect electronic signatures?
faq_plan.a: Yes. The app can capture each party's e-signature on the sublease record, along with the date signed. Whether an e-signature suits your sublease depends on your lease and local law. Ask an attorney before you rely on one.

faq_plan.q: How can a sublease form help me vet a subtenant?
faq_plan.a: Give the form fields for the subtenant's current address, employer, a previous landlord's contact, and two references. For a fuller check, send the subtenant a tenant screening form first and keep its result with the sublease record. Ask the subtenant before you contact anyone they list.

faq_plan.q: What is the difference between a sublease form and a sublease agreement?
faq_plan.a: A sublease form collects the information, and a sublease agreement is the contract. A sublease is a new contract between the original tenant and the subtenant, and the form gathers the details and approvals that contract needs. Sublease forms can carry the signatures too, but have an attorney review the agreement's wording.

faq_plan.q: Can a sublease form work out the subtenant's share of the rent?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Tell the form how the rent splits, by square feet, by room, or as a fixed amount, and it works out the subtenant's share from the answers. A subtenant taking 1 of 3 equal rooms on a $2,400 rent pays $800 a month. Describe the split in your prompt, and Emergent builds the calculation into the form.

faq_plan.q: Can a sublease form send repair requests to the right person?
faq_plan.a: Yes, once the sublease record says who handles repairs. Record whether the subtenant contacts the tenant or the landlord, as your lease and sublease set out, then add a maintenance request form that emails each request to that person. Every request arrives with the unit and the sublease dates attached.

plan.angle: The top 10 is PDF and fill-in template sites (sublease agreement templates, several of them state-specific). A PDF ends at the signature line and leaves the tenant to chase the landlord's consent, the roommates' OK and the rent math by hand. This page shows a sublease form that collects the parties, dates, rent and deposit, works out a partial-space rent share, sends consent requests to the landlord and roommates, captures both parties' e-signatures, and keeps each sublease as a row the tenant or manager owns. It gives no legal or state-specific advice: every rule about subletting is advice to read the lease and check local law with an attorney.
